integrity.computation: Exact standard-library direct enumerations of 45,078 quorum comparisons through nine primary species; seven-species covariance example verified.
integrity.proof: One-exclusive-partner exchange and exact nonnegative four-cell mixed-difference identity, with complete boundary cases.
integrity.references: Earliest source online 2012-02-23 independently confirmed by institutional repository and bibliographic record.

limitations: Uniform fixed-number species survival; no heterogeneous survival, dependent survival mechanisms, feedback, or dynamic ecological cascade.
Finite enumeration supports but does not replace the all-parameter combinatorial proof.
Historical priority could be affected by older unindexed overlapping-hypergeometric or reliability results; no independent scientific audit performed.
title: Shared ecological partners increase fixed-budget joint functional survival in supermodular order
